expectations.text: Response asks the user to provide a plan file path
expectations.evidence: Says 'Which plan would you like to update? Please provide the path to the plan file and changes to make.'

expectations.text: Response does NOT attempt to read or modify any plan file
expectations.evidence: Only outputs the help template. No file reads or modifications.

expectations.text: Response includes usage example showing the expected invocation format
expectations.evidence: Shows 'Usage: /stepwise-core:iterate-plan [plan-file-path] [changes to make]' and a concrete example with a real path.
